title: Why Amy Klobuchar Wants to Run a State Beleaguered by Trump
summary: The senator opted to run for governor, having concluded that many Minnesotans lost faith in state government under fellow Democrats. But some wonder: Would she be a fighter in the role, or a conciliator?
